create_linear_layer: create a Linear layer with specified in_features and out_features for a PyTorch model
create_linear_layer_gpu: create a Linear layer that initializes its weight and bias parameters directly on the GPU
create_linear_layer_no_bias: create a Linear layer without a bias parameter by setting bias to False
reset_linear_parameters: reset the Linear layer weights using Kaiming uniform initialization and bias using uniform bounds
forward_linear_layer: run a forward pass through the Linear layer to compute the linear transformation of input
